events.symptom: GitHub Windows build jobs can be slow or stall
events.corrective_action: Prefer ChatGPT local build and tests; bound CI timeout; avoid repeating unchanged failures
events.acceptance_test: Missing inputs fail preflight; duplicate jobs bounded; no infinite polling

events.symptom: PowerShell CTest config arguments were previously reported to cause repeated CI failures
events.corrective_action: Use CTest's supported configuration argument and test it before a Windows job
events.acceptance_test: Windows CTest completes and reports results separately from compilation

events.symptom: Held notes/chords freeze or fail to release after sustain or preset switching
events.corrective_action: Track per-note ownership and sustain/release; safely flush note-offs on transport/bypass/preset transitions
events.acceptance_test: Polyphonic note-on/off, sustain pedal, rapid preset switching and panic pass across two formats

events.symptom: Reported 88.2 kHz crash under host playback
events.corrective_action: Reproduce using 88.2 kHz process blocks, oversampling state and host configuration
events.acceptance_test: Host playback and release behavior at 44.1/48/88.2/96 kHz remain stable

events.symptom: GUI redraws or recreates on pointer movement or parameter changes
events.corrective_action: Cache static layers; send state deltas; repaint changed regions; avoid rebuilding DOM/editor
events.acceptance_test: Mouse movement/automation produces stable frame and reasonable CPU use

events.symptom: Native GUI omitted canonical HTML labels, font nuances and visual details
events.source_ref: recent Albedo JUCE Native development feedback
events.corrective_action: Compare all canonical labels, styles and behavior at fixed scale and DPI
events.acceptance_test: Automated label inventory and screenshot/interaction parity on primary/compact sizes

events.symptom: Multipart archive/link failure prevented successful extraction
events.corrective_action: Use complete volumes with manifest and hashes; extract independently
events.acceptance_test: SHA-256, 7-Zip full extraction and Windows binary scan pass

events.symptom: JUCE Native (No WebView2) and HTML/WebView2 variants need distinct internal and distribution metadata
events.corrective_action: Preserve distinct host IDs and descriptive filenames/metadata; no silent mixed renderer
events.acceptance_test: Host lists variants unambiguously and saved states remain isolated
